description: Source code implementing SHA1-summed file write infrastructure with functions for hashing, flushing, verifying, and managing hash files, used in Git for data integrity.

methods.name: verify_buffer_or_die
methods.description: Verifies buffer content against check buffer, terminates on error.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes buffer to disk, verifying if check_fd is set.

methods.name: hashflush
methods.description: Flushes current hash buffer, updating hash context.

methods.name: finalize_hashfile
methods.description: Finalizes hash, writes result, performs cleanup, and closes files.

methods.name: discard_hashfile
methods.description: Closes files and frees hashfile structure.

methods.name: hashwrite
methods.description: Writes data to hashfile, updating hash and CRC.

methods.name: hashfd_check
methods.description: Creates hashfile with check file for verification.

methods.name: hashfd_internal
methods.description: Internal function to create hashfile with specified buffer and progress.

methods.name: hashfd
methods.description: Creates hashfile with default buffer size for non-progress use.

methods.name: hashfd_throughput
methods.description: Creates hashfile optimized for throughput with progress reporting.

methods.name: hashfile_checkpoint
methods.description: Stores current state of hashfile into checkpoint.

methods.name: hashfile_checksum_valid
methods.description: Validates checksum of data against stored hash.
